context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified for 'DataTable is not defined' on Inventory. All 5 DataTable pages (utstyr, personer, lag, utlan, brukere) tested and clean. Login flow uses data-testid='login-email', 'login-password', 'login-submit' and redirects to /app on success.
rca of the issue: Inventory.jsx was referencing <DataTable /> without the corresponding import, causing a ReferenceError at render. Main agent added 'import DataTable from "@/components/DataTable"' which resolves the error. Verified via browser navigation + console error capture - zero ReferenceError/pageerror events on /app/utstyr after fix.
